question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少

    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了

    SELECT 
        p.category,

        SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 8 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS aug_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id

)

FROM monthly_sales
WHERE aug_qty > july_qty

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    GROUP BY o.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    net_sales,
    running_total / total_sales AS cumulative_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

sql:
WITH relevant_products AS (
    SELECT sku_id
    FROM dim_product
    WHERE category = '碳酸饮料'
),
relevant_outlets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.outlet_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    JOIN rel_outlet_sku ros ON o.outlet_id = ros.outlet_id
    JOIN relevant_products rp ON ros.sku_id = rp.sku_id
    WHERE ros.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      AND (ros.delisted_date IS NULL OR ros.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
),
listed_combos AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_listed
    FROM relevant_outlets ro
    CROSS JOIN relevant_products rp
),
selling_combos AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fs.outlet_id, fs.sku_id) AS total_selling
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
    WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.month = 8

      AND fs.outlet_id IN (SELECT outlet_id FROM relevant_outlets)
)

    CASE 
        WHEN lc.total_listed = 0 THEN 0

FROM listed_combos lc, selling_combos sc

    JOIN dim_outlet d ON f.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
    WHERE dd.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY d.region
)
SELECT c.region,
       (c.cur_net - p.prev_net) / NULLIF(p.prev_net, 0) AS growth_rate
FROM current_sales c
LEFT JOIN prev_sales p ON c.region = p.region
ORDER BY c.region

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(fs.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fs.outlet_id) AS current_output
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(fs.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fs.outlet_id) AS last_year_output
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    cp.channel,
    cp.current_output - lyp.last_year_output AS output_change
FROM current_period cp
LEFT JOIN last_year_period lyp ON cp.channel = lyp.channel
ORDER BY cp.channel
